title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Pod Vape Kit
description: The Doozy Infinity Pod Kit is an incredibly compact, lightweight and beginner-friendly vape device designed for smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with minimal setup. Featuring effortless inhale activation, a built-in 650mAh battery, and a satisfying, fixed airflow, this kit offers a reliable and fuss-free experience ideal that makes it ideal for everyday use. The Infinity Kit is pre-fitted with a 0.8ohm refillable pod, designed for use with silky smooth Nic Salts or perfectly balanced 50/50 e-liquids. The pod features an integrated coil and a secure bottom-fill mechanism that helps reduce leaks while making refills quick and simple. The fixed-coil design means there are no messy coil changes: just replace the pod when needed. A discreet LED battery indicator keeps you informed of remaining power, while USB-C charging ensures fast recharging with minimal downtime. With its palm-sized, pocket-friendly form factor and easy-to-use operation, the Infinity Kit is a great choice for newer vapers or more experienced users seeking a compact backup device. Please Note: This kit dose not come with a USB-C charging cable. We Recommend using the following E-Liquid with these pods: 0.8ohm - Use Nic salt or 50/50 (freebase) E-Liquids Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
